effective_config.derpp_allocation_adaptation: Classwise reservoir at 200/class replaces official global reservoir; objective and two independent memory minibatches retained; shared class-balanced CE and Adam/MLP protocol
effective_config.derpp_coefficient_source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aimagelab/mammoth/e75a491c69fd729edeb01431afb753d9157d9a81/models/config/derpp.yaml (seq-cifar100, buffer500); transferred fixed coefficients, not NIDS-tuned

policies.access: Only current task training rows and checkpoint002 resident memory. No old pool revisit, new memory, test retrieval, hyperparameter search, or test feedback.
policies.adam: Raw gradient dot products do not guarantee Adam protection. Features/head block norms/dots and actual cloned displacements are diagnostic. Zero-gradient updates include existing moment and second-moment decay, not a no-update model.
policies.competitor: NSL R2L and CIC DoS were fixed from previously inspected TRAIN traces. Exploratory choice, not held-out selection. A wrong predicted family alone does not identify its training gradient as the cause.
policies.components: Whole-minibatch CBCE weights and denominator are retained. Current rare rows contribute gR, all remaining rows gN; original extra rare CE belongs to gR. Fixed competitor component uses the same whole-batch weights.
policies.cost: All five conditions share component-gradient construction and perform one Adam step plus identical probe forward rows. Real-path and added diagnostic costs are separate; different original arms are not claimed equal FLOPs, time or working memory.
policies.estimand: F(full)-F(rare_only) is the conditional one-step effect of including nonrare gradients on fixed rare TRAIN mean CE, holding prestate/batch fixed. F(full)-F(rare)-F(nonrare)+F(zero) records nonadditivity. Not an additive gradient attribution or a test generalization estimate.
policies.intervention: Pre-completed-step grid 0,50,...1950; next batch has five clones from identical model and Adam m/v/step. Explicit zero gradients advance Adam state. Each clone takes one step and evaluates identical fixed training/resident probes, then is discarded. Full clone is the compute-matched sham.
policies.publication: Per-row NPZ, endpoint PT and minimal prestate PT payloads are LOCAL ONLY. Publish only summarized JSON and sanitized source/config; fixed training row IDs are hashed in public metadata.
policies.real_path: Original loss.backward and Adam step, task3 only, exactly 2000 real steps; common verified checkpoint002, original current/memory/candidate/class/index schedules. No optimizer-gradient replacement.
policies.resume: Same-identity checkpoints every50 real steps contain Adam, audit/events and local raw traces. Completed durable steps are skipped; unsuccessful work after a durable boundary is failed-attempt cost, not a replicate.
policies.scope: Exploratory one-step component intervention on eight existing MIR/MIR+rareCE paths. No novelty, final-improvement, historical-step recovery, RQ1/RQ3 or overall completion claim.
policies.trace: Step0 and every real post-update step record each current rare training row and fixed old rare resident row's prediction, true-minus-max-other margin and competitor ID. Prepared row IDs and resident-prefix indices have separate namespaces. New measurements, not recovered historical traces. Original every50-step aggregate trace is also retained.
